title: Every public page ships the Space theme-kit code and the sign-in client that it does not use

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail:
Two shared chunks load on every anonymous public page. One (184 KB raw, 59 KB on the wire) is Space theme-kit client code (Wildheart, Temple, Network kit, moon phases, a location lookup) and is about 98% unused outside a themed Space. The other (238 KB raw, 63 KB on the wire) is the browser database client, about 95% unused for a signed-out visitor. Total script on a public page is 520 to 634 KB on the wire, and CSS arrives as 9 to 12 files (116 to 133 KB). Find what statically imports the theme kits from a shared layout or shell and move it behind the Space route; load the browser client only where a signed-out page actually calls it. Related: SCAN-1265 (home blocking time). Measure with the phone field run before and after.

Theme-kit half closed by PERF-030/031/032 (static walk from 13 public entry points now reaches no site-kit block). Browser database client: the support chat launcher on the (marketing), (help) and discover layouts warmed its panel chunk, which statically carries supabase-js through use-support-chat, on requestIdleCallback, so every public visit downloaded about 63 KB it never ran. It now warms on pointer enter, focus or touch start. Residual, not a public page: the signed-out /events renders inside the member shell, whose dock chat, composer and room thread import the browser client statically.

verify.note: Fails on main: the support chat launcher warms its panel (and supabase-js) on idle. Passes when it warms on intent only and no public entry point reaches site-kit code or the browser database client.
